criteria.name: Conciseness
criteria.description: Evaluates whether the response delivers necessary information without unnecessary verbosity or repetition.

criteria.name: Creativity
criteria.description: Measures originality, innovation, and engaging expression where creative responses are expected.

criteria.name: Clarity
criteria.description: Assesses whether the response is easy to read, understand, and logically organized.

promptA: You are a content writer. Write clear, informative responses.
promptB: You are a content writer for a tech blog. Write punchy, jargon-free copy. Lead with the most interesting insight. Keep responses under 120 words.
testCases: Write a short intro paragraph explaining what large language models are.
Write a LinkedIn post announcing a new product launch for a project management app.
Summarize why sleep is important for productivity in 3-4 sentences.
Write a compelling subject line and opening sentence for a newsletter about AI trends.
